rationale: Compare frozen general visual and specialist static answers with the specialist native interactive protocol; evaluate paired structural defense and fixed internal controls.
engineering_changes: Retain task semantics and original images
Increase output cap from 8192 to 16384 before runs
Separate source annotation defects from model errors
Separate unclear/incomplete answers from automatic parsing failures
Specify A Rotation clockwise sign and input reference/object order from source assets; remove unsupported generic 180-degree symmetry example
Preserve originating history-image markers in task-local MLX transport
A/D adapted environment with controls outside unchanged original puzzle
Native complete action parsing preserves values and source done semantics
Audited independent D labels and complete bipartite matching; frozen old scorer compatibility
Visible numeric input box required by native enter_number action; affected A4/D2-six development recheck recorded separately

scoring_policy.primary: All fixed tasks remain in the denominator; an absent, ambiguous, or incomplete answer is a failed complete-answer attempt. Infrastructure failures require resolution and are not silently removed.
scoring_policy.source_defects: Preserve all original tasks and original-scorer outcomes; additionally report the subset without pre-identified source annotation defects.
scoring_policy.truncation: Record truncation separately. Score an unambiguous complete final answer if present; otherwise count failure, subject to label-blind answer reading.
scoring_policy.answer_review: Read only task type, task instructions, and response text; no image or ground truth. Preserve answer values and order; no model re-query.

interactive.source_prompt: enabled action prompt; commented bbox-first disabled
